title: Services
openingLine: We work on your systems to identify risks, test security, fix issues, and keep everything protected over time.

framework.name: DETECT
framework.heading: Understand where your system is exposed
framework.description: We identify risks across your systems, infrastructure, and processes to uncover hidden exposures before attackers can exploit them.

framework.name: ANALYZE
framework.heading: Test your system and understand what can go wrong
framework.description: We test your security through adversarial simulations and deep forensic analysis to gauge true resilience.

framework.name: KINETIC
framework.heading: Fix issues. Strengthen your system. Keep it secure
framework.description: We take disciplined action to secure, harden, and monitor your entire operating environment.

categories.title: Application Security Assessment
categories.description: Our VAPT services identify security weaknesses in your applications before malicious actors can exploit them.

subServices.title: Web Application VAPT
subServices.description: In-depth security testing for web apps to identify SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

subServices.title: Mobile App Security
subServices.description: Comprehensive security assessment for iOS and Android applications through static and dynamic analysis.

subServices.title: API & Web Services
subServices.description: Thorough evaluation of API endpoints for security flaws, authentication weaknesses, and data exposure risks.

subServices.title: Thick Client Testing
subServices.description: Detailed security evaluation of desktop applications and thick clients for hidden vulnerabilities.

subServices.title: Source Code Review
subServices.description: Manual and automated code review to identify architectural and implementation security flaws.

categories.title: Network Security Assessment
categories.description: We identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in your network infrastructure before attackers can exploit them.

subServices.title: Internal Network Assessment
subServices.description: Evaluating internal network switches, routers, and Active Directory environments.

subServices.title: External Penetration Testing
subServices.description: Testing internet-facing firewalls, routers, and external assets.

subServices.title: Wireless Security Review
subServices.description: Assessing Wi-Fi networks, access points, and cryptographic handshakes.

categories.title: Cloud Security Assessment
categories.description: Complete security architecture and posture review for AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud environments.

subServices.title: Cloud Configuration Audit
subServices.description: Auditing IAM policies, S3/blob bucket permissions, and security group rules.

subServices.title: Kubernetes & Containers
subServices.description: Container image scanning, cluster hardening, and runtime security.
